answer: Tether each identity to a live signal. Twice a day the ledger broadcasts a short-lived beacon - like a comet, visible for minutes then gone - and every active account must return it signed within its own session nonce. A sybil rancher can pre-write a fable of fake histories, but clones must each poll and answer the beacon in real time, so influence costs per-identity bandwidth and clock, never replay. Idle masks simply fade; a mirror network of shared signatures fails the nonce check.
